Australia Wins Women's T20 World Cup Final Against England

Australia has won the Women's T20 World Cup, defeating England by 7 wickets in the final match. This victory marks Australia's record seventh T20 World Cup title. The match was played at Lord's, with England being the host nation and previously undefeated at home in the tournament.
